Sneha knows your business has been slow for months, and you know she has been careful with money but generous with friends.
opener: Apologise and propose a monthly repayment schedule.

private_lines.Aditya: You live alone in a rented one-bedroom flat in Kothrud, Pune, and work as a freelance graphic designer from a laptop, often at a café. Your days start late, with chai and a slow start, then client emails and design work until evening, with cricket on the phone some nights.
private_lines.Sneha: You live in Baner, Pune, with a cousin in a shared flat, and you work as a pharmacist at a busy chain pharmacy. Your days are structured around shifts, usually from nine to six, with evenings spent cooking dinner and watching shows.

situation: A friend who owes money, and the friend they owe.

text: hey. can i call you tonight? about the money
Just got home. Tell me what it's about before I pick up. I'd rather not be surprised.
yeah fair. i owe you and ive been dodging it. should have said something months ago. im sorry
i want to pay you back properly. i worked out a monthly amount i can actually do, not promises i cant keep
Okay. I appreciate you saying that. What's the amount?
8k a month starting 1st dec. till its cleared. i know thats slow. ill send a screenshot of every transfer so you dont have to chase
Eight thousand is doable for you? Be honest. Not a number you'll miss by the second month.
honest answer is its tight. two projects coming in nov should cover it. if they dont i'll tell you before the 1st not after
Okay. Put it in writing so we both have it. The amount, the date, and that you'll tell me early if it slips.
ok
ill send it tomorrow
Dinner's on. I'll call after. I'm not doing this with a pan in my hand.
ok no rush. chai and cricket on my end anyway 😅
Calling now.
Fine. Dec 1, 8k, and early warning if it slips. Write it down.
wrote it. thank u for being chill about it. i know you didnt have to be
going to sleep soon. will send the first one on the 1st
cant sleep. sorry for the late texts. the match ended in a draw lol
still awake. the draw was honestly the worst result. anyway. go sleep, i'm just talking to the ceiling
You didn't sleep at all?
slept from like 3. woke at 6:50 and thought about the 8k for an hour
it's not a bad thing to think about. just not at 6:50
Eat something before you open the laptop. Please.
chai is eating. chai is my breakfast 😅
Shift's starting. Rush already, someone's brought in three prescriptions for the same pharmacy wallet. I'll be on the floor till six.
good luck. don't let the wallet guy get to you
at the café. the guy next to me is on a call about his NFT project for 40 min. i feel very old
also i opened the spreadsheet for the november invoices and closed it again. progress
Off shift. Did you open the spreadsheet again or just think about it?
ok that's fair. i opened it. the two projects are both "pending approval" which is designer for "maybe"
i'll ping both clients tomorrow morning. not tonight, i'm too tired to be polite
Tomorrow morning, then. Tell me what they say, even if it's bad.
yeah. promise
Did the wallet man leave, or is he still arguing with the counter?
left. took his wallet and two of the prescriptions. so a win
going to bed early for once. promise
Good. Set an alarm and don't open the spreadsheet before you ping them.
up. doing the emails now before i talk myself out of it
sent both. bluebird replied already. "approval next week, we're just swamped" which i'll take
the other one hasn't replied. but priya at the agency forwarded me to accounts and accounts says budget's frozen till january. so the nov invoice is probably not happening
so yeah. the 1st is going to be tight. i wanted to tell you before the 1st like i said
Thank you for telling me now. Is "frozen till January" a no, or a maybe with a bad date?
probably a no. they said they'll "revisit" which is the same word as pending approval. i'm learning designer vocabulary is all lies
i can do 3k on the 1st from what i have left. i can't promise more until bluebird pays
Okay. 3k on the 1st is a real number. I'd rather have that than 8k you can't pay. Put down what you'll send and when Bluebird pays, and I'll wait for that date without chasing you.
writing it down. i feel like shit about the 8k though. i said it like it was sorted
You didn't lie on Monday. You're telling me now, which is what I asked for.
ok
at the café again. the NFT guy is back, now on a call about a different NFT project. the grind continues
did u eat
A samosa from the stall outside. Don't ask me to be proud of that.
i wasn't going to. i was going to say eat a real lunch
Shift's back on. Let me know when Bluebird writes. Actually, don't. Let it be a normal afternoon.
Off shift. Anything from Bluebird?
yes. they approved the invoice. payment on the 14th. so the 1st is 3k, then the rest after the 14th if they pay on time, which they never do
i'm putting that in the sheet and then closing it. really closing it this time
Good. Tell me on the 14th when it lands, not when they say it will.
ok 😅
cricket on mute. just chai and the dark
still awake. the 1st feels far and close at the same time. anyway. going to try again
